mentions.name: SingTrace
mentions.description: This mobile app helps people practice singing. The free version records daily practice sessions and keeps an archive of each song's practice history, while the paid version adds analysis of the user's vocals.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I recently made a mobile app for practicing singing: https://singtrace.karamagic.com

The free version you can record and keep an archive of your daily practices of each song, while a paid version does some analysis of your vocals.
